#define PM_PARSE_VALUE(result, error) \
    asm volatile("cpi r16, 0x20
	brne " error "
	" PM_INTEGER_PARSE_OR_BRANCH_ASM(error) \
        "
	cpi r16, 13
	brne " error : "=r" (result) : : "r16", "memory", "cc")
edits.new:
#define PM_PARSE_VALUE(result, error) do { \
    register uint8_t delimiter asm("r16"); \
    asm volatile("" : "=r" (delimiter)); \
    if (delimiter != 0x20) asm volatile("rjmp " error : : : "cc"); \
    asm volatile(PM_INTEGER_PARSE_OR_BRANCH_ASM(error) \
        : "=r" (result) : : "r16", "memory", "cc"); \
    asm volatile("" : "=r" (delimiter)); \
    if (delimiter != 13) asm volatile("rjmp " error : : : "cc"); \
} while (0)
